I'm also here for the George Floyd protesters. This is absolutely essential. I'll do a commission for anyone who donates $50 or more to the Minnesota Freedom Fund and DMs me with proof.

Fuck the police. #BlackLivesMatter

https://t.co/Y0owx0x4cK

"all lives matter" is just perpetuating ignorant complacency because it sounds nice while also conveniently avoiding the critical issue at hand: Black people in America are being killed by cops. Period. It's institutional racism against Black people. Don't get it twisted. #BLM

Remember when Morpheus was telling Neo about people in the matrix? How even if they're 'innocent', they're still a part of the system- a system designed to keep people enslaved, and that they'll fight to protect it? Violently if necessary.

Ain't that just like cops? #ACAB #BLM
IG challenges and changing one's profile picture are all temporary. Allyship shouldn't be. #BlackLivesMatter shouldn't just be a fever pitch. I think about this constantly.
